Four anchored-structure families on 60m, 2024-10-06..2026-09-30, per symbol (MES MNQ MGC MCL). F1 anchored-VWAP +-k*sigma fade (7 anchors: rth open, 18:00 globex open, week open, month open, highest-volume bar of trailing 20 sessions, widest-range bar of trailing 20 sessions, 5-bar swing pivot; k in 0/1/2; warmups 5 and 3). F1b the same bands traded as continuation. F2 naked POC (session and weekly) as magnet and as fade, plus a 10-session revisit-rate test vs random prices in the same range. F3 Fibonacci 0.382/0.5/0.618/0.705/0.786 anchored at prior RTH session, prior week, overnight Globex range and an ATR-ZigZag impulse leg, traded with the impulse. F3b the same levels traded as trend-failure. F4 merged-timeframe LVN confluence (LVN on >=2 of 1-session/1-week/1-month/3-month 60m profiles within 0.25 ATR) traded as continuation, vs single-window LVNs. One geometry for every arm: next open +-1 tick, stop = level -+ (0.5 ATR14 + 1 tick), target 1.5R, 12-bar time exit, flat at session close, one position at a time. IS = first 60% (search, no claims), OOS = last 40% (one confirmation per family per symbol). 348 IS variants; 24 OOS tests; bar 2.521. Result: 0 of 24 pass.
